items: No Playwright/browser automation is installed; acceptance uses provider/component tests, real SQL endpoint evidence, bundle scans, and production preview app-shell checks.
Risk horizon columns not exposed by the bounded top-machines endpoint are shown as Not available rather than inferred.
Energy Consistency loads a bounded sample of at most five machines and does not infer cabinet-to-machine KWh.
L1 threshold series is not drawn when the API does not expose the validated threshold field.
The Vite chunk-size warning remains; code splitting is outside scope.
